title: Time wheel
description: A time you set by turning a wheel, in two styles: flat, as on iOS (the neighbours shrink and fade), or a drum (the rows sit on a cylinder). Hours and minutes in 24 or 12 hours with an am/pm column, one highlight bar across the columns. Drag, mouse wheel, click a row, or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on a focused column (instant). Wheel is one column on its own, for any list.
